scope: Read-only review; no workload launch, source edits or runner edits.
conclusion: Bounded execution, current fixed commands and primary success parsing are sound. Recommended audit/reproducibility hardenings sent to root before launch; these are not source correctness findings.
verified: One outer exclusive machine lock covers both runs; nested job.run(lock_held=True) prevents self-deadlock. Each command has a 180-second process-group timeout.

Known prior commands yield one-worker and six-worker async churn, 64 MiB cache / 32768 pages (128 MiB), two-second warmup and five-second measurement. Same frozen controlled-final driver binary is hash checked.
Selected library is matched to the passing async-mask validation manifest before waiting; LD_LIBRARY_PATH is replaced from async-load to async-mask.

Job success requires exit 0, which covers final eviction and cleanup in the frozen C harness. Parser requires equal field/value lengths, churn/async identity, zero errors/writes/major faults, and positive ops/read bytes/async waits.
I/O counters are measured after warmup. Async wait counts include warmup and measurement; they establish exercised asynchronous waits but not a timed wait rate.
Only the newly created command database is deleted after success; failures retain job logs and scratch.
recommendations: Recheck library SHA under the acquired lock and record exact source hash plus validation-manifest SHA, rather than relying solely on the check before waiting.
Set CACHE_PROBE_DISK_RATIO=16 and CACHE_PROBE_ADDRESS_LAYOUT=spread explicitly; job.run otherwise inherits those variables and previous churn commands did not record overrides.

Assert two expected run configurations/threads {1,6}; require exactly one CSV header and result row, assert row threads and warmup match fixed command/environment, and record output success only after both.
If process is already blocked in flock, restart/requeue to load changed Python; editing the file does not affect a waiting process.
limitation: Bounded correctness/progress smoke only; inherited admission-progress limitation remains unresolved and timings are not a disk-performance comparison.

follow_up.decision: Leave already queued runner frozen; root confirms no source/library mutations while queued/running and inherited optional CACHE_PROBE variables were unset. Verify effective configuration and post-run identities independently.
follow_up.status: Prepared and syntax checked only; to run after complete mask-churn-validation.json exists.
follow_up.interpretation: Original recommendations are audit hardening suggestions, not a request to rerun the bounded workload solely for metadata.
